newsitem.title: ITALY: De Benedetti studying French ventures -press.
newsitem.headline: De Benedetti studying French ventures -press.

text.p: Italian entrepreneur and former Olivetti chairman Carlo De Benedetti is planning to take a minority stake in France's Cie des Signaux as well as a partnership with "the mobile telephony company of Bordeaux", weekly news magazine Panorama said.
Panorama said in an article to be published in its Friday edition that De Benedetti would use his French holding Cerus to carry out the operations.
The article said that electronics firm Cie des Signaux, with a turnover of 700 billion lire, had synergies with Sasib, the engineering group controlled by De Benedetti's CIR industrial holding.
De Benedetti said in a newspaper interview earlier this month he wanted to look for new ventures in France.
Last November Cerus sold its 28 percent stake in French car parts maker Valeo.
